title: AI in Healthcare
author: Dr. Smith
content: Machine learning and artificial intelligence are used in medical diagnosis, patient monitoring, and healthcare decision support.

title: Deep Learning for X-ray Analysis
author: Dr. Ali
content: Deep learning models can detect disease patterns from X-ray images and improve medical image analysis.

title: Knowledge Graphs for Research Discovery
author: Dr. Chen
content: Knowledge graphs connect researchers, papers, topics, organizations, and datasets to support discovery and recommendation.

title: Natural Language Processing in Hospitals
author: Dr. Smith
content: Natural language processing can extract clinical information from hospital notes and electronic medical records.

title: Search Engines for Scientific Documents
author: Dr. Khan
content: Elasticsearch supports full-text search, ranking, filtering, and highlighting for large scientific document collections.

title: Graph-Based Recommendation Systems
author: Dr. Chen
content: Graph-based recommendation systems use relationships between users, documents, topics, and organizations to recommend relevant content.
